data.narrative:
Apex Space is a Series D-stage space and aerospace company founded by Ian Cinnamon and Max Benassi, currently valued at $2.3B post-money following $718M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis references a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Impulse Space, Varda Space Industries, and others at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier from the last post-money valuation of $2.3B, implying $3.5B. Peer-median benchmarking across four same-sector comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Impulse Space ($4.3B Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B Series D), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—yields a median of $2.9B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public comp anchoring via P/S multiple (24.6x median across the sector) cannot be applied absent the target's disclosed revenue.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $2.5B to $4.0B, with a median of $3.2B. The current $2.3B valuation sits below this range, reflecting the recency of the last financing round. Key uncertainty centers on revenue trajectory and unit economics relative to the peer set's wide dispersion ($1.1B–$8.0B), which suggests material stage or business-model variance among comparables.
